title: Close handed-off session tabs after the successor starts
body: Outcome: no handed-off KRN session stays open to auto-compact and burn tokens. `scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts` starts the successor with an instruction (or a SessionStart step) that, once the successor has read its handoff, closes the immediate predecessor's Herdr tab and every other "handed off → …" tab in the same KRN workspace whose agent is idle; tabs of other workspaces and working agents are never closed. `.agents/skills/krn-handoff/SKILL.md` step 3 is updated (today: "the immediate predecessor stays open"). Operator 2026-11-03: "żebyś historyczne taby zamykał… autokompaktowanie… wpierdala nam to tokeny" (memory:close-handed-off-tabs). Proof: an observer with a fake `herdr` on PATH, red at base by assertion: predecessor tab closed after successor start; other-workspace and working tabs untouched.
